data.headline: NVIDIA revenue doubles as long Treasury yields stay elevated
data.summary: NVIDIA reported $115.8 billion in revenue for the quarter ended October 25, up 103% from a year earlier. The latest captured ten- and thirty-year Treasury yields were 5.12% and 5.46% on November 16.

bull.text: The company reported quarterly GAAP diluted earnings of $2.70 per share, up from $1.30 a year earlier.

bear.text: The thirty-year benchmark yielded 5.46% on November 16, 20 basis points above November 9.

watch.text: Management’s $130 billion fourth-quarter revenue outlook has a range of plus or minus 3%. The quarter has an additional week.

limitations: The NVIDIA figures cover one issuer. The packet lacks matched analyst expectations and a measured post-release price response.
The Treasury figures are the November 16 benchmark observations.
